projects.title: Self-hosted Home Lab
projects.description:
• Built and operated a 4-GPU server with OpenAI-compatible API for local LLM inference via vLLM and llama-server
• Self-hosted 15+ services via Docker Compose with Healthchecks.io heartbeats and custom software for observability
• Implemented encrypted off-site backup using BorgBackup to Hetzner
• Designed and implemented a real-time computer vision pipeline (Frigate NVR + YOLO + VLM) for automated pet safety event detection, achieving sub-3s latency

organizations.name: Anthro Art Association
organizations.description:
• Planned and executed a successful recruiting campaign that increased membership by 220% in the first year
• Orchestrated internal fundraising efforts, more than doubling the club budget
• Managed multiple activities with record-high turnout
• Developed club website with React
